title: The /themes page remembers the last kit in view, so the 12 minute launch starts from it
detail: use-kit-showcase.ts calls rememberKit (lib/create-space/last-kit.ts, #4642) for the kit section in the middle of the window; a kit the builder does not offer is skipped.

verify.evidence: Fails on main (no fold rules, old wording), passes on the branch. Measured in a browser: every kit's button and devices end inside the window at the four desktop sizes.

source.ref: Owner, 2026-11-04: whoever reaches the launch has the theme they were looking at
